• Modern Cyber Loading Animation: 120 FPS holographic dual-ring gyro with breathing Delta prism core and sweeping laser energy scanlines

• Rebalanced Settings Dialog: Relocated Master Trading Execution Mode (Demo vs Live) into the About section under OTA Updates for a clean shape
• 120 FPS Fluid Performance: DirectX 11 DirectComposition pipeline, zero-copy shaders, and debounced price tick stylesheet updates
• Top-Level Navigation Architecture: Dedicated full-screen Trading History section with [ 🏠 Home ] and [ 📜 Trading History ] segmented navigation tabs
